# HPUK News site: create the lists from CSV

<!-- Generated by SharePointGovernance/tools/build_list_csvs.py from the solutions' list-schema.json. Don't edit. -->

For Site Owners without the PnP provisioning scripts (no client ID needed). Each CSV makes one list with the columns the flows expect. The provisioning scripts do the same thing automatically, so use one route or the other, not both.

## How to import a list

1. On the site, select **New > List > From CSV** (or **Lists > New list > From CSV**) and pick the file.
2. Name the list **exactly** as given below. The flows find lists by name.
3. In the preview, set each column's **type** from the table. Leave the column names as the
   headers (they are the internal names the flows use). If a column offers a choice of title
   column, use **Title**.
4. **Create.** Then, in the list:
   - delete the EXAMPLE rows
   - in **List settings**, for each column: rename it to the display name in the table, tick
     *Require that this column contains information* where Required says Yes, set the default,
     and check the choices
   - hide the columns marked *hide from the new / edit form* (*Edit columns* on the form, or
     the column's settings)
   - add the columns marked *add by hand*
   - index the columns marked *index it* (*List settings > Indexed columns*)
   - turn on **Versioning** (*List settings > Versioning settings*)
5. **Check the internal names.** Open each column's settings: the address ends `Field=<internal
   name>`, which must match the table exactly. A header SharePoint already uses gets a number
   added (for example `Category0`). If that happens, delete the column and add it by hand with the
   internal name.

Create lists that others look up first (the order below already does this).

## Lists

### Site Pages

The Site Pages library on BOTH news sites (HPUK News and Other News), with identical columns and internal names. News posts are pages with PromotedState 2. Content approval is off: publishers are pre-approved, so a published page is live straight away.

**No CSV: built into every site (add the columns in the library's settings).** Add these columns by hand (*Add column*), using the internal name as the first name you type, then rename:

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Department` | managed metadata |  | Yes | term set Communications/Department | add by hand |
| `Category` | managed metadata |  | Yes | term set Communications/Category | add by hand |
| `Strategy_x0020_Theme` | managed metadata | Strategy Theme |  | term set Communications/Strategy theme | add by hand |
| `Port` | Choice (allow multiple selections) |  | Yes | All ports, Felixstowe, Harwich, Thamesport |  |
| `Expiry_x0020_Date` | Date and time (date only) | Expiry Date |  |  |  |
| `ShowinNews` | Yes/No | Show in News |  | default Yes |  |
| `Status` | Choice |  |  | Live, Expired; default Live |  |
| `Urgent` | Yes/No |  |  | default No |  |
| `Include_x0020_in_x0020_Weekly_x0020_Roundup` | Yes/No | Include in Weekly Roundup |  | default Yes |  |
| `UrgentSent` | Yes/No | Urgent alert sent |  | default No |  |
| `NotificationRound` | Number | Notification round |  | default 1 |  |

### Notices and Attachments

Document library on HPUK News for notice attachments, linked from posts. Major versioning on.

**No CSV: a document library: create it with New > Document library, then add the columns.** Add these columns by hand (*Add column*), using the internal name as the first name you type, then rename:

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Department` | managed metadata |  | Yes | term set Communications/Department | add by hand |
| `Category` | managed metadata |  | Yes | term set Communications/Category | add by hand |
| `Port` | Choice (allow multiple selections) |  | Yes | All ports, Felixstowe, Harwich, Thamesport |  |
| `ExpiryDate` | Date and time (date only) | Expiry date |  |  |  |
| `Status` | Choice |  | Yes | Live, Expired; default Live |  |

### News Videos

Document library on BOTH news sites for video used in news posts. Videos play through Stream (on SharePoint) and are added to a post with the File and media web part. Same permissions as the site (publishers edit, readers view); major versioning on; covered by the 7-year retention. No external video embeds.

**No CSV: a document library: create it with New > Document library, then add the columns.** Add these columns by hand (*Add column*), using the internal name as the first name you type, then rename:

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Department` | managed metadata |  |  | term set Communications/Department | add by hand |
| `CaptionsChecked` | Yes/No | Captions checked |  | default No |  |

### Notices Archive

Read-only list on HPUK News holding historical notices migrated from Internal Notices. Edit rights: configuration maintainers only, during migration.

**CSV:** `Notices_Archive.csv`. *New > List > From CSV*, name the list exactly **Notices Archive**, then set each column's type as below. After it's created, delete the 2 EXAMPLE rows.

**Add by hand after the import** (a CSV can't create these): `Department` (managed metadata, term set Communications|Department); `Category` (managed metadata, term set Communications|Category).

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SourceId` | Single line of text | Source item ID | Yes |  |  |
| `OriginalCreated` | Date and time (include time) | Originally created | Yes |  |  |
| `OriginalModified` | Date and time (include time) | Originally modified |  |  |  |
| `OriginalAuthor` | Single line of text | Original author |  |  |  |
| `NoticeText` | Multiple lines of text | Notice text | Yes |  |  |
| `AttachmentLinks` | Multiple lines of text | Attachment links |  |  |  |

### Comms Distribution

One row per destination for C2 and C3: one per port, plus optional company-wide rows (Port = All ports) that receive every post in the Monday roundup and never get urgent alerts. Edit rights: configuration maintainers only.

**CSV:** `Comms_Distribution.csv`. *New > List > From CSV*, name the list exactly **Comms Distribution**, then set each column's type as below. After it's created, delete the 4 EXAMPLE rows.

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Port` | Choice |  | Yes | Felixstowe, Harwich, Thamesport, All ports |  |
| `EmailGroup` | Single line of text | Email group |  |  |  |
| `TeamId` | Single line of text | Team ID |  |  |  |
| `ChannelId` | Single line of text | Channel ID |  |  |  |
| `Enabled` | Yes/No |  |  | default Yes |  |
| `BusinessOwner` | Person | Business owner | Yes |  |  |

### Delivery Log

One row per dispatch key from C2 and C3. Title is the dispatch key, unique and indexed: the flows reserve it (Reserved) before sending, then set Sent, Failed (definitely not delivered; the only status that is ever retried) or Reconcile (outcome unknown; a person checks with the recipient and sets Failed to allow a resend). A row left Reserved is not proof of delivery (the run may have stopped before sending): set it to Sent only when the recipient confirms, otherwise Failed. Edit rights: flow identity and configuration maintainers only; readers: support owner.

**CSV:** `Delivery_Log.csv`. *New > List > From CSV*, name the list exactly **Delivery Log**, then set each column's type as below. After it's created, delete the 7 EXAMPLE rows.

| CSV header = internal name | Type to choose | Then rename to | Required | Choices / default | After import |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SourceSite` | Single line of text | Source site | Yes |  |  |
| `PageId` | Number | Page ID | Yes |  |  |
| `PublishedVersion` | Single line of text | Published version |  |  |  |
| `NotificationRound` | Number | Notification round |  |  |  |
| `Destination` | Single line of text |  | Yes |  |  |
| `Channel` | Choice |  |  | Email, Teams |  |
| `DeliveryStatus` | Choice | Delivery status | Yes | Reserved, Sent, Failed, Reconcile, Skipped - not an urgent publisher, Skipped - audience targeted, Skipped - no destinations |  |
| `DeliveredAt` | Date and time (include time) | Delivered at | Yes |  |  |
| `ErrorDetail` | Multiple lines of text | Error detail |  |  |  |
| `FlowRunId` | Single line of text | Flow run ID |  |  |  |
